svg.text: ShareGPT | Cold + Warm | DRAM prefetch OFF vs ON
Qwen3-14B BF16 | DRAM 256GiB | GPU staging 8GiB | concurrency 16 | chunk 128 tokens
421 conversations x 4 fixed-history turns = 1,684 requests/phase. Same live cache from cold to warm within each arm.
Warm: mean TTFT 5.36% lower | elapsed time 5.96% lower | input reuse 98.16% in both arms
*Reuse = cached input tokens / all input tokens. Tier hit ratios use initial lookup candidate chunks (different denominator).
Each arm: cold fill -> drain staging/mirror -> warm replay. Between arms: fresh process, empty DRAM, new DAOS namespace.

svg.text: All charts: x = seconds since phase start; y = percent. Independent time axes. 20ms samples, 2-second bins.
Table peak uses allocation events; charts can miss short peaks. Staging includes reads and stores, not GPU compute utilization.
One trial per arm; identical cached-token counts per request, but some outputs differ. No capacity-attributed recomputation observed.
